notes.title: Small update with a few fixes!
notes.notes:
Heya gobs!

We’ve updated the game with a few fixes and changes based on some of the reports and feedback we received!

General

 Thrumby’s Clean off - Adjusted some of the messes to make them easier to spot
 Fixed a clipping mesh in the wyrmdoor tickets ending cutscene
 On a second playthrough the fairy cage can now be examined again instead of being treated as a familiar form of currency
 Fixed an issue where the quality options were blank by default
 Fixed a user-interface issue that failed to show the gamepad shortcuts for the pryers and the knife


Localization All Languages

 Fixed a few missing lines that were reverting back to english


Localization German

 Removed the € symbol from the gob-speak lines as it ended up being more distracting than charming
 Fixed a handful of minor issues


Thank you for all of your kind words and feedback, it’s been really heartwarming to read.

Best,
The Leafy Games Team
